result.title: Decision-Centric Research: A Calibrated Decision Model and Benchmark for Scientific Agents
result.summary: Scientific agents make consequential choices about evidence, next actions and research strategy, but choices embedded in generated text are difficult to evaluate independently. Decision-Centric Research (DCR) is introduced to make individual choices the common unit of supervision, prediction and evaluation through typed predictions over an explicit Research State. DCR defines 24 decision types, ten of which are instantiated in the Research Decision Benchmark (RD-Bench) of 2,000 rule-generated cases. The Decision-Centric Research Model (DCRM) shares a candidate-token readout across types to produce answers and option probabilities in one forward pass. Under a held-out research-domain split, a 0.6B DCRM (state-aware) achieves 89.4% Top-1 accuracy, compared with 27.8% for DCRM (question-only) trained with the same recipe and 36.4% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. All 30 type-seed comparisons against DCRM (question-only) are significant after Holm correction. After held-out calibration, the resulting prediction sets contain a mean of 1.515 candidates at 97.1% empirical label coverage, reducing mean set size by 57.4% relative to DCRM (question-only) at similar coverage. These results establish a compact state-aware decision layer with accurate typed prediction and an inspectable uncertainty interface.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出以显式 Research State 上的类型化决策作为监督、预测与评估单元，构建 24 类决策框架、2,000 例基准及共享候选 token 读出的小模型，并用校准预测集呈现不确定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其状态条件下的决策预测与校准预测集，可能为 LVR 中「思考/查看/停止」判定及不确定性接口提供概念参照，但任务与多模态视觉推理相距较远，可供核查可迁移性。
